scope: L02 §21.2 assignment routing through workspace retry and report presentation

checks: overlapping real report export and assignment, dismissal guard, one-shot share, explicit export failure
payload, exact and stale identities, one-shot warm/cold routing, saved conflict, editor/map deferral
real repository lock, exact cold route after retry, stale route consumed after authoritative open
workspace/outbox, checklist, restoration, draft JPEG and Settings byte preservation
independentReview: Original router consumed the valid cold intent while the real repository lock prevented startup.

Corrected router held the original intent through the lock failure and opened the exact saved task once after retry. Stale UUID combinations refused. Saved conflict and workspace bytes were preserved.
Original report callback lost the share when the assignment owned the sheet.
Corrected owner presented the report or its error once after dismissal. A second assignment waited behind it.
Independent A/B used the original callback bodies in a host harness. SwiftUI wiring was inspected in source.
